# Original Zalo 1.5 UI fixtures

These five unmodified QML screens come from the user-supplied `Zalo1.5.bar`
(SHA-256 `9bc76e228c1b457b64dcbb637f71636bc6dbc32ba8f014dda8fd0648ae78101c`).
They exercise the compatibility UI migration without redistributing the input BAR
or requiring a BB10 SDK in tests. Zalo10 upstream is BBerryLife/Zalo10 (GPLv3);
the application license is retained beside these fixtures. Test ELF data is synthetic
and generated separately; it is not the original executable.
